title: Quiz: Testing Your Code
description: Check your understanding of Testing Your Code.

questions.question: Which of these is the correct way to write a comment in Ruby?
questions.explanation:
In Ruby, # marks a comment. Block comments use =begin
=end.

questions.question: What is the most valuable first test for a new function?
options: A normal input with a known expected output
Random data with no expected result
questions.correctAnswer: A normal input with a known expected output
questions.explanation: One known-good case proves the function basically works.

questions.question: True or False: Code that runs without errors is always correct.
questions.explanation: This statement is incorrect — review the lesson.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: assert result == ___   // check the expected value
questions.explanation: Assertions compare actual output to expected output.

questions.question: In Ruby, what is the safest way to predict what a program outputs?
options: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.correctAnswer: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.explanation: Read top to bottom, track variable values, and note every output statement.
